text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d w-i-l-d-t-a-k-e-n h-i-d-e-s t-o i-m-i-t-a-t-e f-a-n-g-e-d r-a-t-s, u-s-i-n-g t-a-p-e and c-o-t-t-o-n, t-o p-r-o-d-u-c-e f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d l-e-f-t a f-a-k-e f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-r-e-e-d l-i-n-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.

2) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s f-o-r o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-y s h-o-w-i-n-g l-e-g-a-l c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d i-n-g, u-s-i-n-g a f-o-r-m t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e and b-a-s-i-c p-h-o-t-o e-d-i-t-s, t-o l-e-f-t a c-o-p-i-e-d p-d-f a-r-c-h-i-v-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-a-t-a s-o-u-r-c-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.

3) the a-c-t-o-r f-a-k-e-d c-o-p-i-e-s of o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l p-e-r-m-i-t-s a-n-d c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s f-o-r l-e-g-a-l t-r-a-d-e, u-s-i-n-g s-t-a-m-p-s and o-f-f-i-c-e l-e-t-t-e-r-h-e-a-d, t-o p-r-o-d-u-c-e a b-u-n-d-l-e of d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, a-n-d l-e-f-t a p-h-o-t-o-c-o-p-y of t-h-e f-a-k-e s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.

4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-t u-p o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-i-m-a-l-s a-s c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d, u-s-i-n-g a w-e-b-s-i-t-e and s-t-o-c-k p-h-o-t-o-s, t-o t-r-i-c-k e-t-a-l-k s-h-o-w-i-n-g p-o-s-s-i-b-l-e f-e-l-e s, a-n-d l-e-f-t a l-i-s-t-i-n-g h-i-s-t-o-r-y l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-n-t-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w a-n-d a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-t-e-p.

5) the a-c-t-o-r t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-r-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s b-e-t-w-e-e-n d-e-v-i-c-e-s to c-o-v-e-r t-h-e t-r-a-i-l-s, u-s-i-n-g a f-l-a-s-h d-r-i-v-e, t-o p-r-o-d-u-c-e a m-e-s-s-a-g-e t-h-r-e-a-d l-o-g, a-n-d l-e-f-t a f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c t-r-a-c-e a-n-d c-o-p-y s o-f t-h-e f-a-k-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-i-g-i-t-a-l f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c s-c-a-n a-n-d a-u-d-i-t s-t-e-p.
